title: alp-sdk camera module (v1)
description: A purchasable camera module (sensor + FPC/board + oscillator) under metadata/camera_modules/<module_id>.yaml.  The sensor silicon lives in metadata/chips/<chip>.yaml; this file carries the module-level facts that the chip cannot know: which I2C address the module straps to, the oscillator it carries, and how many CSI-2 data lanes the module routes.  `module_id` reuses the Zephyr shield name where a shield exists.

module_id.description: Unique id; must equal the file stem.

chip.description: chip_id of the sensor in metadata/chips/.

xclk_hz.description: Frequency of the module's own oscillator / sensor input clock.

lanes.description: CSI-2 data lanes the module routes to its connector.

zephyr_shield.description: Name of the zephyr/boards/shields/<name> shield for this module, when one exists.

zephyr_host_overrides.description: Properties a Zephyr shield generator must set on the SHARED capture-host nodes (not on the sensor node) for this module to stream, keyed by the host node's devicetree `compatible` (e.g. `snps,designware-csi` for `&csi`, `vsi,isp-pico` for `&isp`).  Values are DT scalars: integer, string or boolean (true = bare property).  Captures the per-module bench-proven CSI-2 host timing / ISP crop that is not derivable from the chip or the lane count.
